label: XS-010X-Q XGS-PON SFU ONT
description: Nokia XS-010X-Q single-port XGS-PON SFU ONT (ITU-T G.9807.1, 10G/10G symmetric, SC/APC BOSA): one auto-sensing 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ-45 Ethernet port, Layer 2 bridging only, no Wi-Fi or voice, managed by OMCI/AMS - used to feed a router or mesh base unit from a 10G PON drop.
